cases.public_summary: Generalized near-group ring R′(4). No braided category lies in the Morita class of a categorification. Existence remains unresolved.
Free of rank two over its Ising fusion subring. Central Frobenius–Schur and invertible-lift obstructions leave one possible relative-center based ring.
